verdict.rationale: Quo documents a public REST API with API-key auth, JSON responses, and published rate limits. It also publishes downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 specs, a date-based versioning policy with deprecation commitments, and a per-endpoint "Try it" playground that runs against production. The openapi probe returned 404 only at generic root paths, while the spec is published on S3, so this does not contradict the claims. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully driving the API end-to-end, and a spec served at a standard discoverable path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Quo API enables developers to integrate powerful communication features directly into their applications and workflows.
